claims.claim: Redwire's own SEC-filed transaction disclosure identifies inability to convert backlog into revenue, dependence on partially funded/terminable government contracts, need for additional funding, equity dilution, preferred-stock voting dilution, significant holder influence, integration risk, debt-service constraints, and declining Ukraine-linked Edge Autonomy revenue as explicit downside mechanisms.

riskSupport.risk: Backlog is not equivalent to realized economics because orders may fail to convert and government contracts may be partially funded or terminated.
riskSupport.mechanism: funding/program change or termination -> delayed/reduced backlog conversion -> weaker revenue/cash conversion
riskSupport.falsifier: sustained funded backlog conversion with improving cash generation across multiple reporting periods

riskSupport.risk: Acquisition financing and capital structure can transfer resilience costs to common holders through dilution and debt-service burden.
riskSupport.mechanism: acquisition/working-capital funding -> additional equity/preferred/debt -> dilution or fixed financing burden -> reduced common-holder flexibility
riskSupport.falsifier: integration produces durable positive free cash flow and leverage/funding needs decline without further material dilution

riskSupport.risk: Edge Autonomy adds geopolitical/customer-mix sensitivity because a significant portion of its revenue was linked to Ukraine and the filing states those sales had been declining and could decline further with conflict/support changes.
riskSupport.mechanism: Ukraine conflict/support normalization -> lower customer demand -> weaker acquired-business revenue/mix -> integration economics below expectations
riskSupport.falsifier: customer/geographic diversification offsets Ukraine-linked declines while acquired-business margins and cash conversion remain durable

observedWeakness: The capital structure, acquisition integration and government/Ukraine-linked demand exposures are issuer-disclosed risks; they are not evidence that failure is occurring now.
uncertainty: This filing establishes mechanisms and issuer-recognized exposures but does not by itself quantify Alpha's current numeric risk or valuation impact.
improvementPath: Alpha can combine these source-addressed mechanisms with the current 2026 10-Q cash, debt, dilution, customer mix and backlog-conversion data to construct reproducible risk evidence without treating narrative risk factors as numeric scores.
